learnings.name: 2026-10-17-demo-seed-one-data-module-demo-claude.md
learnings.text:
---
title: "Demo seed: one data module (demo_data.py) + a guarded loader; screenshot extras folded in"
author: Claude
date: 2026-10-17
branch: feat/demo-seed-refresh
cost: { minutes: 9, tokens: 57571 }
touches:
  - CHANGELOG.md
  - CLAUDE.md
  - README.md
  - VERSION
  - docs/admin-guide/installation.md
  - docs/index.md
  - scripts/screenshots/README.md
  - scripts/screenshots/capture_collab.py
  - scripts/screenshots/seed_extras.sql
  - tests/test_demo_data.py
---

## Decided
- The demo tenant's data lives in `app/scripts/demo_data.py` as plain dicts keyed by names (e-mails, project/phase/equipment/tag names) with every date relative to `today`; `build_demo(today)` is pure and tested without a DB (`tests/test_demo_data.py`: referential integrity, single-select tags, site-restricted tags, card_status pairs, dependency `entity` + no cycles, PM site membership, `[R:…]` pattern, mention placeholders, ordered ranges, holiday years).
- `seed_demo.insert_demo_data(conn, demo)` resolves names → ids with `INSERT … SELECT … WHERE NOT EXISTS` + `SELECT id` per row (`_insert_id` / `_insert_once`), so a partially seeded DB is completed, never duplicated; dependencies are written only where empty; comment bodies use `{mention:<email>}` placeholders that become `@[Full Name](id)` and `mentioned_user_ids` comes from `parse_mention_ids(body)`. `tests/test_seed_demo.py` runs it against a recording asyncpg fake (every INSERT guarded, FK order, ids, JSON, read_at).
- `scripts/screenshots/seed_extras.sql` is gone; the pipeline is seed_demo alone. `capture_collab.py` looks the Catalyst phase up and restores its dates in `finally` instead of PUTting hard-coded 2026 dates on phase 8.
- Bank holidays are static rules (`easter_sunday`, `swiss_holidays` ZH, `german_holidays` HE) for this year and next — no Nager call in the seed.
- Kept the skip-if-seeded check (no `--reset`, user decision: a fresh Codespace is enough).

## Tried and ruled out
- Keeping SQL in the screenshot pipeline: hard-coded ids (staff 2–5, site 1) and fixed 2026 dates went stale within months.

## Watch out
- `ruff check tests/` has pre-existing failures in old test files (import order / unused imports); CI lints `app/` only. Don't "fix" them in an unrelated PR.
- `tests/test_init_db.py` has its own `FakePg`; the seed tests use a separate `RecordingConn` because the loader only needs execute/fetchval.

learnings.name: 2026-10-17-follow-ups-pr-defaults-aligned-dead-claude.md
learnings.text:
---
title: "Follow-ups PR: defaults aligned, dead code removed, undefined CSS tokens, UI_GUIDELINES.md"
author: Claude
date: 2026-10-17
branch: fix/claude-md-audit-follow-ups
cost: { minutes: 90, tokens: 714184 }
touches:
  - UI_GUIDELINES.md
  - frontend/src/styles/variables.css
  - frontend/src/styles/__tests__/cssTokens.test.ts
  - migrations/run_migration.py
  - app/config.py
  - ".github/workflows/version-check.yml"
---

## Decided
- Migration runners default MASTER_DB_NAME to milestone_master like the app; docker-compose.fresh.yml, the devcontainer and the admin docs keep milestone_admin on purpose (existing volumes hold that database). tests/test_follow_up_defaults.py keeps the runner defaults equal to Settings.master_db_name.
- SSO_* settings removed from app/config.py and .env.example (extra=ignore keeps old .env files loading). upgrade_to_v90.sql no longer adds predefined_phases.is_system/color.
- UI guidelines live in UI_GUIDELINES.md at the repo root (turbo-ea structure, Milestone content, every token named per theme); docs/developer-guide/frontend-ui.md was removed from the docs site.
- src/styles/__tests__/cssTokens.test.ts guards that every var(--x) read is defined (global token, component-scoped CSS property, or inline style via '--x': / ['--x' as string]: / setProperty). It found 12 undefined tokens (--space-2/3/4, --accent-teal, --radius-xs, --primary, --border-primary, --status-danger, --accent-green-alpha, --text-warning, --bg-tertiary-rgb, --border-color-subtle); all replaced with canonical tokens, --accent-teal and --accent-green-alpha added.
- @types/node added as a devDependency so a Vitest test can read the filesystem (tsconfig includes src, and Vitest returns a CSS-module stub, not text, for import.meta.glob('*.module.css', '?raw')).

## Tried and ruled out
- Removing cascadeDependentPhases/Subphases: they are dead but tested (6 cases); deleting them only lowers the coverage total the CI floor sits under, so the header comment was fixed instead.
- npm uninstall from the wrong directory: a Bash cwd reset dropped a stray package.json/package-lock.json in the repo root; always cd inside the same command and check git status for root manifests.

## Watch out
- Python 3.13 has no wheels for asyncpg/psycopg2-binary: run the backend tests from a Python 3.11 venv (uv venv --python 3.11).
- Node 22 in the sandbox vs engines >=24: npm only warns; lockfile diffs stayed minimal.
- UI_GUIDELINES.md debt lists (raw inputs, checkbox vs ToggleSwitch, overlay close rules, row-action sizes, aria labels, alert(), focus trap) are the backlog for the next UI PR.
